## Football Scoreboard v0.1.0

Initial release of the Football Scoreboard: a configurable, always-on NFL and NCAA football scoreboard for a Raspberry Pi display.

### Features

- Live scoreboard and game details, including scoring plays and drive information.
- Team selection and configurable display behavior.
- Raspberry Pi setup, kiosk-mode, and systemd service instructions.

### Installation

See the [Raspberry Pi setup guide](https://github.com/nicholasfrei/football-scoreboard/blob/v0.1.0/docs/raspberry-pi.md) to install and run the app.

### Notes

- Requires Node.js 20 or newer.
- This release does not yet configure automatic nightly updates; that will be documented once the updater is in place.
